title: festival-voice.persona.v1
description: One voice agent persona: a name, prompt, brain-model, and TTS overlay. A persona carries no STT, VAD, tools, skills, meeting, or speaker settings; those are always inherited from app config. Generated from internal/persona.Profile and kept in step by TestPersonaSchemaMatchesProfile.

id.description: Kebab-case id. Must match the containing directory name and names the persona's prompt document.

display_name.description: Becomes agent_name when this persona is active.

builtin.description: True only for the shipped samantha persona, which cannot be deleted.

brain.description: Per-persona model routing. Empty fields inherit the app-level brain keys, so profiles written before this field existed behave exactly as before.

provider.description: Brain backend (ollama, claude, grok). Empty keeps app-level brain_provider.

model.description: Provider-specific model id, routed to ollama_model or grok_model. Claude has no app-level model key, so a persona-level Claude model is recorded but not routed.

tts.description: Per-persona TTS backend and voice. provider selects the engine; voice is the speaker id for that engine (Kokoro name or Qwen preset).

provider.description: TTS backend (e.g. kokoro, qwen3-tts). Empty keeps app-level tts_provider.

voice.description: Speaker id for the effective provider (Kokoro voice or Qwen CustomVoice preset).

tier.description: Native Qwen3-TTS model tier: 0.6b for latency, 1.7b for quality. Only read when the effective provider is qwen3-tts; empty inherits qwen_tts_model_tier. Canonicalized on persist, so 1.7 is stored as 1.7b.

prompts.description: Catalog refs for prompt documents. persona is the system identity; turn is an optional short per-reply voice instruction (empty = shared default). turn is not a conversation counter and is independent of tts.voice.

persona.description: Catalog name of the kind=persona system prompt. Usually the persona id (prompts/persona/<id>.yaml).

turn.description: Optional catalog name of the kind=turn per-reply instruction. Empty uses the shared embedded default. Not the conversation turn counter; not a TTS voice id.
